statement_en:
Let $(X,\mathcal{A},\mu)$ be a measure space, let $T:X\to Y$ be measurable, let $T_{*}\mu$ be the pushforward measure, and let $g$ be an integrable function on $Y$. Then
$$\int_{Y}g\,d(T_{*}\mu)=\int_X g\circ T\,d\mu.$$
